section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 1
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: (1)These rules may be called The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011. (2) They shall come into force on the 1st day of April, 2011.

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 2
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
scope: Rule 2(a)-(l) and Rule 2(n)-(q); includes final unlettered general definition clause; Rule 2(m) is represented by PCR2011-R2-M-MRP-FORMAT
raw_text: Definitions (a) through (l) and (n) through (q), establishing terms such as dealer, manufacturer, lot, maximum permissible error, net quantity, principal display panel, retail package, standard package, and wholesale package. Includes a final unlettered/general clause stating words defined in the Act shall have the meanings assigned to them in the Act.

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 2(m)

condition.format: Printed as 'Maximum or Max. retail price Rs/.......inclusive of all taxes' or in the form 'MRP Rs/.........incl., of all taxes'

source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 3
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: The provisions of this Chapter shall not apply to,- (a) packages of commodities containing quantity of more than 25 kg or 25 litre excluding cement and fertilizer sold in bags up to 50 kg; and (b) packaged commodities meant for industrial consumers or institutional consumers.

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 4
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: no person shall pre-pack or cause or permit to be pre-packed any commodity for sale, distribution or delivery unless the package in which the commodity is pre-packed bears thereon or, a label is securely affixed thereto such declarations as are required to be made under these rules. The existence of packages without the declaration of retail sale price within the manufacturer's premises shall not be construed as a violation provided all packages leaving the premises have the declaration.

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 5
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: The commodities specified in the Second Schedule shall be packed for sale, distribution or delivery in such standard quantities as are specified in that Schedule.

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 5 proviso
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: Provided that if a commodity specified in the Second Schedule is packed in a size other than that prescribed in that Schedule, a declaration that 'Not a standard pack size under the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 or 'non standard size under the Legal Metrology (packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011' shall be made prominently on the label of such package. (Provision will stand withdrawn wef 01.07.2012 vide GSR 748(E) dated 24.10.2011).

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 6(1)(a)

condition.field: name and address of the manufacturer, packer, or importer
exemptions: packages containing food articles (Rule 6(1)(a) is displaced; governed by Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 and rules made thereunder)

source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 6(1)(b)

condition.field: common or generic names of the commodity (and name and number/quantity of each product if multiple)

source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 6(1)(c)

condition.field: net quantity (in standard unit of weight, measure, or number)

source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 6(1)(d)

condition.field: month and year in which the commodity is manufactured or pre-packed or imported
exemptions: packages containing food articles (governed by applicable food law)
packages containing seeds (only where labelled and certified under the Seeds Act, 1966 and its rules)
packages containing cosmetics products (governed by Drugs and Cosmetics Rules, 1945)
any package containing bidis or incense sticks
any domestic liquefied petroleum gas cylinder of 14.2kg or 5kg, bottled and marketed by a public sector undertaking

source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 6(1)(e)
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: The retail sale price of the package is generally required. For packages containing alcoholic beverages or spirituous liquor, State Excise law/rules apply in the State of manufacture; if applicable State Excise law/rules do not require retail-sale-price declaration, these Rules apply. Bidi packages and domestic LPG cylinders whose prices are covered by the Government’s Administrative Price Mechanism are excepted.

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 6(1)(f)
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: Where the sizes of the commodity contained in the package are relevant, the dimensions of the commodity contained in the package and if the dimensions of the different pieces are different, the dimensions of each such different piece shall be mentioned.

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 6(2)

condition.field: name, address, telephone number, e mail address, if available, of the person who can be or the office which can be, contacted, in case of consumer complaints

source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 6(3)
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: It shall not be permissible to affix individual stickers on the package for altering or making declaration required under these rules: Provided that for reducing the Maximum Retail Price (MRP), a sticker with the revised lower MRP (inclusive of all taxes) may be affixed and the same shall not cover the MRP declaration made by the manufacturer or packer on the label.

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 6(4)
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: It shall be permissible to use stickers for making any declaration other than the declaration required to be made under these rules.

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 6(5)
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: Where a commodity consists of a number of components and these components are packed in two or more units, for sale as a single commodity, the declaration required to be made under sub-rule (1) shall appear on the main package and such package shall also carry information about the other accompanying packages (or given on individual packages with intimation on main package). Spare parts must have declarations on each package.

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 6(6)
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: Any packaging material or wrapper which could not be exhausted by the manufacturer or packer, may be used for packing of the material up to 31st March, 2012, or till such date the packaging material or wrapper is exhausted...

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 7(1)

condition.field: required information for package having capacity of 5 cubic cm or less
condition.must_appear_in_zone: card or tape affixed firmly to the package

source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 7(2)
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: Numeral height tables: Table I (weight/volume) - Up to 200 g/ml: 1mm (2mm blown/molded); >200 to 500 g/ml: 2mm (4mm blown/molded); >500 g/ml: 4mm (6mm blown/molded). Table II (length, area, number based on principal display panel area) - Up to 100 cm²: 1mm (2mm blown/molded); >100 to 500 cm²: 2mm (4mm blown/molded); >500 to 2500 cm²: 4mm (6mm blown/molded); >2500 cm²: 6mm (6mm blown/molded).

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 7(3)
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: The height of letters in the declaration shall not be less than 1 mm height and when blown, formed, molded, embossed or perforated, the height of letters shall not be less than 2 mm. Provided that the width of the letter or numeral shall not be less than one third of its height, except in the case of numeral '1' and letters (i), (I) and (l).

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 7(4)
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: The provisions under sub-rule (1) to (3) shall not apply to a package if the information to be specified on such package under this rule is also required to be given by or under any other law for the time being in force.

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 8(1)

condition.field: every declaration required to be made under these rules

source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 8(1) proviso
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: Provided that the area surrounding the quantity declaration shall be free from printed information. (a) above and below by a space equal to at least the height of the numeral in the declaration, and (b) to the left and right by a space at least twice the height of numeral in the declaration.

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 8(2)
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: For soft drink, ready to serve fruit beverages or the like, the bottle which is returnable by the consumer for being refilled, the retail sale price may be indicated either on the crown cap, or on the bottle or on both and if indicated on the crown cap or the bottle, it is sufficient to indicate the retail sale price in the form of 'MRP Rs....'.

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 9(1)(a)
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 9(1)(b)
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: Numerals of the retail sale price and net quantity declaration shall be printed, painted or inscribed on the package in a colour that contrasts conspicuously with the background of the label; Provided that (a) where information is blown/molded on glass/plastic it need not be in contrasting colour; (b) handwritten declarations must be clear, unambiguous and legible.

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 9(2)

condition.format: No declaration shall be made so as to require it to be read through any liquid commodity contained in the package

source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 9(3)
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: Where a package is provided with an outside container or wrapper such container or wrapper shall also contain all the declarations which are required to appear on the package except where such container or wrapper itself is transparent and declarations on the package itself are easily readable through such outside wrapper. Provided that no such declarations on the inner package is required if the inner package does not contain any declaration on its outer cover.

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 9(4)

condition.format: either be in Hindi in Devnagri script or in English (use of any other language in addition is permitted)

source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 10(1)

condition.field: complete address of the manufacturer, packer, or importer
exemptions: packages of capacity 5 cubic cm or less (mark/inscription sufficient)

source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 10(2)

condition.field: name of manufacturer, packer, or importer
condition.format: shall be the actual corporate name, or if not incorporated, the name under which the business is conducted in India

source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 11(1)
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: In declaring the net quantity of the commodity contained in a package, the weight of wrappers and materials other than the commodity shall be excluded.

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 11(2)

condition.format: shall correspond to the net quantity which will be received by the consumer, and shall not be qualified by the words 'when packed' or the like (unless exempt under sub-rule 4)

source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 11(3)
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: For commodities subject to negligible environmental variation, the declaration of quantity shall be made after taking into account such variation so that the consumer receives not less than the net quantity declared; the declaration shall not be qualified by words 'when packed' or the like.

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 11(4)

condition.field: declaration of quantity for specific commodities
condition.format: may be qualified by the words 'when packed', as specified in the Third Schedule

source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 12(1)
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: The declaration of quantity shall be expressed in terms of such unit of weight, measure or number or a combination of weight, measure or number as would give an accurate and adequate information to the consumer with regard to the quantity of the commodity.

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 12(2)
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: Except in the cases of commodities specified in the Fourth Schedule, the declaration of quantity shall be in terms of the unit of - (a) mass, if the commodity is solid, semi-solid, viscous or a mixture of solid and liquid; (b) length, if the commodity is sold by linear measure; (c) area, if the commodity is sold by area measure; (d) volume, if the commodity is liquid or is sold by cubic measure; or (e) number, if the commodity is sold by number.

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 12(3)
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: Where the declaration of quantity has been made in terms of mass, the manufacturer or importer, as the case may be, the packer may, at his option make an additional declaration on the package as to the number of commodities contained in the package.

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 12(4)
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: Where the declaration of quantity by weight or measure or number is not sufficient to give to the consumer full information with regard to the dimensions or number of commodity contained in the package, such declaration shall be accompanied by a declaration of the dimensions or number...

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 12(5)

condition.must_appear_in_zone: same panel in which the other information, as required by these rules, have been indicated

source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 12(6)

condition.format: shall not contain any word or expression which tends to create an exaggerated, misleading or inadequate impression (e.g. 'minimum', 'not less than', 'average')

source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 12(6)

condition.format: shall not contain any word or expression of any sort, whatsoever, which tends to create or likely to create an exaggerated, misleading or inadequate expression as to the quantity of the commodity contained in the package

source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 12(7)

condition.field: declaration of quantity for packages having capacity 5 cubic cm or less
condition.must_appear_in_zone: tag, card, tape, or any other similar device affixed to the container

source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 13
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: Units thresholds: Less than 1 kg (gram), 1 kg or more (kilogram, subject to stated fraction options); Less than 1 m (centimetre), 1 m or more (metre); Less than 1 sq metre (square decimetre), 1 sq metre or more (square metre); Less than 1 cubic metre (cubic centimetre/decimetre based on volume), 1 cubic metre or more (cubic metre); Less than 1 L (millilitre), 1 L or more (litre). No dozen, score, gross, or great gross permitted. SI units only; for number-based items, use N or U.

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 14
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: Where a package contains commodities like bed-sheets, hemmed fabric materials, dhoties, sarees, napkins, pillow-covers, towels, table cloths or similar other commodities, the number and the dimensions of finished size of such commodities shall also be declared on the package or on the label affixed thereto... includes provisos for packages containing pieces of different dimensions.

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 15
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: Where the dimensions and weight, or combination thereof, of a commodity has or have a relationship to the price of that commodity, the declaration of quantity on the package containing such commodity, shall also include a declaration as to such dimensions, weight or combination.

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 16
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: In the case of a package containing sheets like aluminum foil, facial tissues, waxed paper, toilet paper or any other type of sheet, the declaration of quantity on the package shall also include a statement as to the number of usable sheets contained in the package and the dimensions of each such sheet.

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 17
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: The commodities shall be expressed as bags, boxes, cups, pans or the like designed and sold in retail trade for being used as containers for other materials or objects and shall be labeled with the declaration of quantity based on their specific geometries (bag-type, rectangular, circular, etc.).

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 18(1)
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: No wholesale dealer or retail dealer or importer shall sell, distribute, deliver, display or store for sale any commodity in the packaged form unless the package complies with in all respects, the provisions of the Act and these rules.

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 18(2)
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: No retail dealer or other person including manufacturer, packer, importer and wholesale dealer shall make any sale of any commodity in packed form at a price exceeding the retail sale price thereof.

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 18(3)
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: Tax-revision procedure and revised-price limits: Outlines rules for retail pricing when tax payable is revised after a commodity has been pre-packed, including advertisement requirements and limits on price increases.

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 18(4)
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: Nothing in sub-rule (3) shall apply to a package which is not required, under these rules to indicate the month and the year in which it was pre-packed.

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 18(5)
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: No wholesale dealer or retail dealer or other person shall obliterate, smudge or alter the retail sale price, indicated by the manufacturer or the packer or the importer, as the case may be, on the package or on the label affixed thereto.

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 18(6)
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: The manufacturer or packer or the importer shall not alter the price on the wrapper once printed and used for packing.

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 18(7)
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: All retailers who are covered under the Value Added Tax VAT or Turn Over Tax (TOT) and dealing in packaged commodities whose net content declaration is by weight or volume or a combination thereof shall maintain an electronic weighing machine of at least accuracy class III, with smallest division of at least 1 g, with facility to issue a printed receipt indicating gross quantity, price etc., at a prominent place free of cost for consumers.

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 19(1)-(3)
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: Inspection and testing of quantity and error in packages at the premises of the manufacturer or packer, outlining sample drawing, obtaining signatures on forms, and reporting findings.

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 19(4)-(7)
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: Provides for fresh tests upon request with a fee of ₹2,500. Outlines conditions under which a lot is approved (statistical average equal/more than declared, no package exceeds maximum permissible error, and mandatory declarations are present).

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 19(8)
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: For non-compliance of the provisions of this rule, action may be taken after seizing five representative samples of the packages as evidence and the rest of the packages may be released (once compliance is ensured) by the manufacturer or the packer, as the case may be.

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 19(8)
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: For non-compliance of the provisions of this rule, action may be taken after seizing five representative samples of the packages as evidence and the rest of the packages may be released only after the compliance is completed by the manufacturer or the packer, as the case may be.

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 20
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: Action to be taken on completion of inspection of packages at the premises of the manufacturer or the packer, including seizure and evidence preservation if average quantity is lesser, error exceeds max permissible error, or declarations are missing.

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 21
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: Inspection of quantity and error in packages at the premises of the wholesale/retail dealer triggered if: (i) complaint about short quantity is received; (ii) suspicion of tampering, pilferage, or leakage; (iii) missing mandatory declarations. Includes safeguard that where package bears 'when packed' legend, no punitive action applies if deficiency is due to environmental conditions.

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 22
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: Establishment of maximum permissible error on packages as indicated in the First Schedule, accounting for standard variations in packaging, exposure, and material nature.

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 23
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: Deceptive packages (designed to deliberately give an exaggerated/misleading impression of quantity) are to be repacked/re-labeled or seized.

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 24
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: Every wholesale package shall bear thereon a legible, definite, plain and conspicuous declaration as to - (a) name and address of manufacturer/importer/packer; (b) identity of commodity; and (c) total number of retail packages or net quantity... Provided that nothing in this rule shall apply if similar declarations are required by another law.

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 25
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: An export package shall not be sold in India unless the manufacturer or packer has re-packed or relabeled the commodity in accordance with the provisions contained in Chapter II...

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 26
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: Nothing contained in these rules shall apply to any package containing a commodity if- (a) the net weight or measure is 10g or 10ml or less; (b) any package containing fast food items packed by restaurant/hotel; (c) scheduled formulations covered under Drugs (Price Control) Order; (d) agricultural form produces in packages of above 50 kg.

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 26(a) proviso
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: Provided that the declaration in respect of maximum retail price and net quantity shall be declared on packages containing 10g to 20g or 10ml to 20ml.

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 27
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: Registration requirements for manufacturers, packers, and importers, including application procedures, fees, and timelines.

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 28
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: Registration of shorter address permissible. The Director or Controller may register a shorter address which can then be lawfully stated on the label.

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 29
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: Maintenance of a public register of manufacturers and packers by the Director or Controller.

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 30
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: Compilation of State-wise lists of registered manufacturers or packers and their circulation to the Controller of the concerned State.

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 31(1)
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: Any advertisement mentioning the retail sale price of the pre-packaged commodity shall contain a declaration as to the net quantity or number of the commodity contained in the package.

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 31(2)
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: The font size of the net quantity in the advertisement shall be same as that of retail sale price.

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 32
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: Penalty for contravention of Rules: Fines specified for violating rules 27 to 31, and general fines for contraventions without specific provided punishments.

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 33
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: Power of the Central Government to relax one or more provisions of these Rules for a reasonable period after ascertaining the genuineness of compounding or court decisions.

section_ref: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 34
source_currency: 2011 rules text with amendments/notes shown in supplied PDF
raw_text: Repeal and savings of The Standards of Weights and Measures (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 1977, detailing preservation of prior rights, liabilities, proceedings, and licenses.
